fields.docs: Seed used when creating a new planning workspace.
fields.name: seed

SavedGame.docs: Current checkpoint data. Hosts version their save envelope and migrate before restore.
SavedGame.name: SavedGame

fields.docs: Selected skirmish factions; campaigns use their authored recruitment.
fields.name: armies

fields.docs: Durable facts about conditions that have been satisfied at least once.
fields.name: condition_memory

fields.docs: Complete persisted combat PRNG state.
fields.name: combat_rng

State.docs: A complete owned battle snapshot suitable for persistence and transport.
State.name: State

Hex.docs: A geometric cell address. Never an authored location name.
Hex.name: Hex

fields.docs: Phase in which this controller acts; this is not its diplomatic relation.
fields.name: phase

fields.docs:
Named factions author their own pool. Prices are recruitment economics,
not modifications to a unit's combat profile.
fields.name: recruits

TurnPhase.docs: The human and automatic turn phases. Factions define diplomatic allegiance.
TurnPhase.name: TurnPhase

fields.docs: Omitted policies inherit the selected enemy/session policy.
fields.name: policy

FactionPolicy.docs: Tactical and recruitment policy, preserving each policy's stable choices.
FactionPolicy.name: FactionPolicy

FactionTransfer.docs:
Transfer the same unit when a shared authored condition is satisfied.
Contextual conditions use the unit's current tile.
FactionTransfer.name: FactionTransfer

ConditionRule.docs: Remembering satisfaction is independent of the predicate being evaluated.
ConditionRule.name: ConditionRule

fields.docs: Exact faction identifier (the authoring key predates faction economies).
fields.name: side

variants.docs: A matching unit stands on a tile currently visible through authored fog.
variants.name: VisibleUnits

TileRef.docs: An explicit authored reference. Runtime positions never use this type.
TileRef.name: TileRef

ConditionSide.docs:
Unit allegiance selectors are distinct from the two turn/ownership phases.
`Any` tests existence without excluding passive or rescued actors.
ConditionSide.name: ConditionSide

variants.docs: The exact viewing faction, never all factions acting in its phase.
variants.name: Observer

GroundItem.docs: An item left on a battlefield tile. Ownership passes only when collected.
GroundItem.name: GroundItem

fields.docs: A carried aura, applied at the start of the carrier's allied turn.
fields.name: healing

Item.docs: Equipment owned by an individual unit, including its granted attacks.
Item.name: Item

TerrainRole.docs: Gameplay meaning of terrain, independent of its authored/artwork identifier.
TerrainRole.name: TerrainRole

fields.docs: Uniform raw roll is damage ± spread, inclusive; omitted means fixed damage.
fields.name: spread

fields.docs: Hits in the selected attack; old definitions retain one hit.
fields.name: count

fields.docs: Percentage of actual HP removed restored to a surviving wielder.
fields.name: drain

Weapon.docs: An authored attack option with independent uniform strike rolls.
Weapon.name: Weapon

DamageType.docs: Physical damage category indexing resistance and terrain modifiers.
DamageType.name: DamageType

Category.docs: Weapon category used to select compatible retaliation attacks.
Category.name: Category

Gold.docs: Treasury balances keyed by faction identifier.
Gold.name: Gold

BattleResult.docs: Mission result is independent of which controller's phase delivered it.
BattleResult.name: BattleResult

fields.docs: Coordinate address (`col,row`), used by commands and snapshots.
fields.name: id

fields.docs: Optional authored landmark identity; ordinary cells have none.
fields.name: location

fields.docs: Owning faction identifier, independent of its turn phase.
fields.name: owner

fields.docs: Road/village exits or opposite crossing edges; artwork only.
fields.name: connections

fields.docs: Short road spurs capped inside this tile rather than meeting another tile.
fields.name: dead_ends

fields.docs: Explicit complete wall edges; never inferred from neighbors.
fields.name: walls

fields.docs: Reusable ground palette; independent of terrain and its gameplay rules.
fields.name: floor

fields.docs: Immutable condition shared by snapshots; Arc keeps native catalogs thread-safe.
fields.name: perception

fields.docs: Terrain light anchored to this tile, using the same contextual rules as fog.
fields.name: light

Tile.docs: A tile snapshot combining authored coordinates with current terrain and ownership.
Tile.name: Tile

HexDirection.docs: Clockwise edge names for a pointy-top hex. These describe artwork only.
HexDirection.name: HexDirection

PublicUnit.docs: An owned unit snapshot preserving stable IDs and optional campaign metadata.
PublicUnit.name: PublicUnit

CampaignState.docs: Persistent chapter progress, recalled companions, story choices and dialogue.
CampaignState.name: CampaignState

EvacuatedUnit.docs: A unit safely removed from the board, retaining identity and belongings.
EvacuatedUnit.name: EvacuatedUnit

Veteran.docs: A surviving unit carried between campaign chapters with its earned experience.
Veteran.name: Veteran

Dialogue.docs: One scripted dialogue line with its speaker, portrait and display text.
Dialogue.name: Dialogue

RefugeCounter.docs: Defended refuge turns and whether mediation has escalated into battle.
RefugeCounter.name: RefugeCounter

Counter.docs: Consecutive defended turns and the last round counted for an objective.
Counter.name: Counter

FlagChange.docs: One explicit flag change. Stage uses the campaign's zero-based mission index.
FlagChange.name: FlagChange

LastCombat.docs: Feedback identifying the latest attack until the next turn clears it.
LastCombat.name: LastCombat
